cbioportal.selection: entrezGeneId=1956, mutation profile and all-samples list from one LUAD study
cbioportal.unit: mutation-call API row; not a distinct patient or a clinical efficacy measurement

civic.filter: EGFR token in molecular_profile; accepted status; DOID:3910 or exact LUAD label when DOID missing
civic.unit: CIViC evidence item; not a patient, variant prevalence estimate, or independent publication

egfr_occurrences.interpretation: A descriptive, project-filtered count among indexed mutation occurrences; neither driver status nor full-cohort prevalence.
egfr_occurrences.privacy: Case identifiers are deduplicated only in memory; none are written to the repository or logs.
egfr_occurrences.unit: Distinct GDC public case identifiers associated with an EGFR simple somatic mutation occurrence

gdc.name: Lung Adenocarcinoma
gdc.note: Project-level metadata. EGFR summary is obtained separately via GDC's public aggregate endpoint.
gdc.unit: GDC project, not a gene-level observation

limitations: CIViC evidence items, cBioPortal mutation-call rows and GDC project case identifiers are different units and study selections; their counts are not directly comparable.
CIViC DOID:3910 uses an exact ontology filter; broader non-small cell lung cancer evidence is excluded even when it might overlap LUAD.
CIViC molecular profiles can be compound; matching the EGFR token does not imply an isolated EGFR alteration.
cBioPortal counts reflect this specific study and assay/profiling coverage, not all lung cancers or prevalence.

GDC case IDs are deduplicated from filtered SSM occurrences in memory. No variant-consequence, driver, or sequenced-denominator filter is applied; this is not a prevalence estimate. A missing response is null, never zero.
Nightly CIViC files and cBioPortal API results are mutable: match source hashes and dates before comparing reruns.
No patient-level records are saved; result has not undergone scientific or clinical review.
scope: Descriptive EGFR/LUAD data coverage; not biomedical or therapeutic inference
